en.t: At last I came down with a fever and lay in bed.

units.source_text: 住持把我送到外科医生那里。

en.t: The abbot sent me to a surgeon.

units.source_text: 身穿国民服、打上绑腿的外科医生给这肿物起了个简单的名称，叫做疖子。

en.t: The surgeon, dressed in a national uniform and wearing puttees, gave the swelling a simple name: a boil.

units.source_text: 他连酒精也舍不得用，在火上烤了烤手术刀，

en.t: He was too stingy even to use alcohol, and merely held the scalpel over the fire,

units.source_text: 消毒过后就动手术了——我呻吟了。

en.t: then, once it was sterilized, began the operation at once; I groaned.

units.source_text: 我感到灼热的抑郁的世界在我的后脑勺裂开、凋萎、衰竭……

en.t: I felt the scorching, melancholy world split open, wither, and fade away at the back of my head...
